title: A Conversational Agentic Interface to Physics-Based Household Digital Twins for Residential Energy Decision Support
publisher: Costas Mylonas, Titos Georgoulakis and Magda Foti / arXiv preprint
finding: A residential-energy prototype connects an LLM interface to GridLAB-D through structured simulation payloads and tool-governed execution. Its evaluation covers 45 curated prompts; this is not a Chinese district-heating field trial.
design: Use the language model to operate numerical tools, with application-generated result cards and separate operator approval.

title: Annex TS9: Digitalisation of District Heating and Cooling
finding: The programme addresses digital infrastructure, data integration standards and communication barriers across the heat chain, including the secondary side.
design: Prioritise asset identity, timestamps and sensor quality before adding autonomous optimisation.

title: The Building Optimization Testing Framework (BOPTEST)
finding: BOPTEST provides building emulators, a control-testing API and KPI reporting for repeatable benchmarking.
design: Benchmark comfort and energy against repeatable baselines. This project reuses its own P1A engine, not BOPTEST.

title: Beijing: intelligent heating upgrades for 431 residential communities
finding: Approved upgrades include sensing, metering and regulation at heat sources, networks, substations and building entrances. The article describes intended outcomes, not independently measured savings.
design: Model station-to-building decisions and show the provenance of every reading.

title: Guangrao smart heating: operational monitoring and service coordination
finding: A municipal example connects heat-source, substation and community monitoring with warnings and maintenance dispatch.
design: Link alarms to assets, checks and an operator action record, rather than only plotting temperatures.

title: Application of secondary network intelligent balance system based on big data analysis
finding: A Chinese secondary-network case study links balancing and indoor-temperature objectives. This is established practice, not a novel 2026 invention; case-study savings are not transferable guarantees.
design: Compare branch redistribution with a station-wide temperature increase.

title: Sensor Fault Detection via Virtual Smart Heat Metering with Spatial-Temporal Graph Neural Networks
publisher: Keivan Faghih Niresi and Olga Fink / PHM Society
finding: A heterogeneous spatial–temporal graph model compares physical measurements with virtual sensing estimates. Evaluation uses a controlled Aalborg laboratory dataset, not this Chinese estate.
design: Keep measured and modelled values separate. This demo injects sensor bias and does not claim to implement the paper's trained model.

title: Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
finding: OT security must account for performance, reliability and safety requirements.
design: No language-model path to physical actuation. Production deployment needs segregated OT integration, permissions and independent controls.

title: Tool and function calling
finding: Models request tools; application code executes them and returns tool results for a subsequent model response.
design: Use an allowlisted server-side tool loop with bounded rounds, visible results and no actuator tool.
